about: The crop–origin registry (Supply outlook foundation, E151): one entry per crop the platform models. life_cycle is the crop's biology — alternate bearing (perennial fruit and nut trees and vines: a heavy crop drains the tree, the next is light) decides whether the bearing cycle is removed before a calibration; annual crops are only detrended. A crop's origins are not listed here: they are every country FAOSTAT reports production for (data/reference/faostat_crops.json). A crop not in this registry is refused, never guessed.
provenance: life cycles carried from ml/features/crop_cycle.ALTERNATE_BEARING_CROPS (2026-08-16, the finding that removing a spurious cycle from annual crops strips real climate variance)

crops.note: FAO's own aggregate (item 1804, 'Citrus Fruit, Total') — FAO's figure, not a sum of ours; its components (oranges, tangerines, lemons and limes, grapefruit, other citrus) are FAO items 490, 495, 497, 507, 512

crops.gap: FAOSTAT does not report durum separately from wheat — held as a named gap
